summary: For Q=U^T H U+2U^T g(T)+r(T), with U independent of environment T, every measurable recentering U->U+psi(T) preserves the anchor quadratic Hessian H exactly. Hence affine-uniform density bounds pass through arbitrary shifts with zero loss, but recentering cannot improve rank, inertia or sigma_min(H). On the exact-target diffuse family A_m=U_0 B_* U_0^T with spectrum {1,1,-1}, every physical 3x3 anchor has sigma_min at most 1/m, so no outside-dependent translation can turn the physical-triple certificate into a universal constant. This is not a QFORM counterexample: grouped bank aggregation controls the same family uniformly by 12 sqrt(pi).
